title: Work-tape head bounds from space
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, let $v$ be an input word, and let $n,t\in\mathbb{N}$ with $n\le t$. In the configuration reached after $n$ steps from the initial configuration on $v$, every work-tape head position lies in the interval from minus the total space used through step $t$ to that total space used.
hypotheses_covered: M is a multi-tape Turing machine
